title: 第二十三章 一拳镇三敌撕破伪善皮囊第二十四章 公堂审三房旧冤大白于众
lines: 赤红烟火余温未散，竹林雾色腥冷刺骨。
三名青风阁武徒二重杀手呈三角死锁站位，封死沈砚前后左右所有退路，三柄淬毒短刃乌蓝寒光交织，蚀骨毒素弥漫空气，周遭翠竹触之发黑，泥土被毒气化腐，滋滋冒起白烟。
断臂杀手倚竹调息，左肩衣衫浸透鲜血，握刃左手青筋暴起，眼底只剩阴狠癫狂：“我二人同门配合，纵横永安郡边境从无败绩，加上我牵制，三重武徒灵力合围，你就算肉身逆天，今日也必死无疑！”
右侧新来杀手身形低伏，脚掌贴地，气息彻底融入竹风，专攻游走偷袭，声线冷硬无情：“柳夫人重金许诺，取你首级，赏高阶淬体丹百枚，外加一处灵脉据点，为钱财，为前程，我们必杀你！”
左侧杀手指尖捻动刃花，目光死死锁定沈砚心口气海，深谙武者命门：“废你气海，碎你根基，让你从新晋武徒，沦为废人，受尽折磨而死！”
三人分工极致分明：断臂杀手正面牵制，游走杀手侧翼袭扰，刃术杀手直击命门。
这是青风阁打磨数年的三角绝杀阵，专为围杀同境强者而生，攻防闭环，进退一体，无数郡域武徒，皆葬送在此阵法之下。
远处回廊，侯府巡逻护卫尽数驻足，隔着竹林外围遥遥观望，无人敢踏入这片杀机之地。
“三名武徒二重合围，沈砚完了。”
“好不容易崛起，一朝身死，终究斗不过三房底蕴，斗不过城外暗杀势力。”
议论声随风飘入竹林，字字判定沈砚死局。
沁柳院高台之上，赵坤手扶栏杆，望着竹林合围之势，放声大笑，眉眼妒意尽数舒展：“天助我也！三面围杀，插翅难飞！沈砚，你的武道之路，到此为止！”
柳氏端坐主位，指尖佛珠缓缓转动，眉眼温婉依旧，可眸底阴翳尽数散开，胜券在握：“三二重围杀，便是侯府老牌武徒执事，都要负伤落败，何况沈砚一个山林速成的武徒。今日过后，竹林埋骨，世间再无沈砚，正午府门澄清，自然作废。”
在她眼里，大局已定，胜负毫无悬念。
竹林合围中心，风卷青衫，猎猎作响。
沈砚抬眸，平视三面杀机，周身浅碧灵力缓缓升腾，没有丝毫慌乱，反倒战意滚烫升腾。
他很清楚，这三人不同于侯府养尊处优的武者，每一招都浸染鲜血，每一式都直指性命，三角阵法互补短板，硬碰硬缠斗，只会消耗自身灵力。
想要破局，不可缠斗，唯有极速破阵，斩首阵眼，以绝对爆发力，打碎阵法核心！
三角阵，必有阵眼！
断臂杀手负伤在身，灵力流转滞涩，是三人之中最弱一环，也是整座绝杀阵唯一破绽！
“布阵！杀！”
不等沈砚动身，三名杀手默契达成共识，同声低喝，周身灵力同时爆发，三道灰色灵力气浪合拢，毒刃齐出，三道夺命刃气封锁空间，挤压沈砚闪避空间，刹那间合围而至！
刃风割裂空气，整片竹林劲风狂暴，成片细竹拦腰断裂，断竹翻飞，毒雾漫天，威压锁死肉身，让人四肢沉重，难以提速。
死局彻底成型！
“以为凭人数阵法，便能压我？”
沈砚唇角冷扬，眼底锋芒彻亮，丹田气海浅碧灵力毫无保留喷涌，体内碧鳞蛟血脉之力瞬间沸腾游走，筋骨轰鸣作响，皮肉表层浮起一层温润碧色灵膜，肉身强度瞬时拔高巅峰状态！
古林血战、蛟兽搏杀、生死厮杀刻入骨髓的本能，在此刻尽数苏醒。
流云碎月步！全速！
脚下步法踏动，落点诡变无双，不闪两侧绝杀刃气，不避漫天蚀骨毒雾，沈砚舍弃周身防御，身形化作一道青色流光，逆着刃风，直线突进，目标直指负伤断臂杀手！
弃守，专攻！一剑破阵！
“狂妄！敢主动冲阵！”侧翼游走杀手瞳孔骤缩，厉声喝斥，立刻调转刃尖，斜斩沈砚腰侧软肋，打算以伤换伤，逼沈砚回撤。
正面刃术杀手同步提速，毒刃直刺沈砚丹田气海，下手狠绝，不留余地。
两柄毒刃，前后夹击，眼看就要刺穿沈砚身躯！
铛！铛！
两声清脆金石碰撞巨响炸响！
毒刃劈砍在蛟血灵膜之上，火星四溅，刃身剧烈震颤，乌蓝毒素根本无法渗透灵膜分毫，仅仅留下两道浅浅白痕，便被肉身蛮力直接弹开！
蛟鳞锻体，同境无解！
“不破防御？这是什么肉身！”两名杀手心神巨震，心底第一次生出极致惶恐。
同境武徒，灵力为本，肉身为辅，这是武道通识，可沈砚颠覆一切常识，灵力浑厚，肉身堪比妖兽，攻防兼备，毫无短板！
content_en:
The remaining warmth of the red fireworks has not dissipated, and the fog in the bamboo forest is fishy and cold.
The three second-level assassins of Qingfeng Pavilion martial arts stood in a triangle deadlock, blocking all escape routes in front, back, and left of Shen Yan. The three poison-quenching short blades were intertwined with black and blue cold light. Bone-corrosive toxins filled the air. The surrounding green bamboos turned black when touched, and the soil was rotten by the poisonous gas, causing white smoke to rise.
The Broken Arm Killer leaned on the bamboo to adjust his breath. The clothes on his left shoulder were soaked with blood, and the veins in the left hand holding the blade were bulging. There was only viciousness and madness in his eyes: "The two of us cooperated in the same sect, and we have never failed across the border of Yong'an County. With my restraint, and the spiritual power of the three warriors surrounding me, you will definitely die today even if your body is against the will of heaven!"
The new killer on the right is lying low, with the soles of his feet touching the ground. His breath is completely integrated into the bamboo wind. He specializes in roaming sneak attacks. His voice is cold and ruthless: "Mrs. Liu promised a lot of money. I will take your head, reward you with hundreds of high-level body tempering pills, and a spiritual vein stronghold. For money and future, we will kill you!"
The killer on the left twisted the blade flower with his fingertips, and his eyes were fixed on Shen Yan's heart and Qi Hai, who knew the destiny of a warrior: "Destroy your Qi Hai, shatter your foundation, and make you a useless person from a newly promoted warrior, and die of torture!"
The division of labor among the three is extremely clear: the arm-breaking killer is a front-on containment, the wandering killer is attacking from the flanks, and the blade-skilled killer is attacking directly at the gate of life.
This is the triangular killing formation that Qingfeng Pavilion has been polishing for several years. It is specially designed to encircle and kill strong men in the same realm. It closes the loop of attack and defense, and integrates advance and retreat. Countless warriors from the county have been ruined by this formation.
In the corridor in the distance, all the patrolling guards of the Hou Mansion stopped and watched from afar through the bamboo forest. No one dared to step into this murderous place.
"Three warriors surrounded by two layers, Shen Yan is finished."
"It took a lot of effort to rise up, but once you die, you will not be able to defeat Sanfang's background or the assassination forces outside the city."
The sound of discussion drifted into the bamboo forest with the wind, and Shen Yan was judged to be dead every word.
On the high platform of Qinliu Courtyard, Zhao Kun held his hand on the railing and looked at the encirclement of the bamboo forest. He laughed loudly and his eyebrows were full of jealousy: "God help me! I am surrounded from three sides and it is difficult to fly with wings! Shen Yan, your martial arts journey ends here!"
Mrs. Liu sat in the chair, slowly turning the beads on her fingertips, her eyes still gentle, but the shadows in her eyes were all gone, and she was sure of victory: "Three or two rounds of sieges, even the veteran martial arts deacons of the Hou Mansion were injured and defeated, let alone Shen Yan, a martial arts disciple who quickly became a mountain forest. After today, the bones are buried in the bamboo forest, and there will be no more Shen Yan in the world. The palace gate is clear at noon, and it is naturally invalid."
In her eyes, the overall situation has been decided, and there is no suspense about victory or defeat.
The bamboo forest surrounds the center, the wind blows through the green shirt, and the sound of hunting is heard.
Shen Yan raised his eyes and looked at the murderous intent on three sides. The light green spiritual energy around him slowly rose. He was not panicked at all, but his fighting spirit was rising hotly.
He knew very well that these three people were different from the pampered warriors in the Hou Mansion. Every move was soaked in blood, and every move was directed at life. The triangle formations complemented each other's shortcomings, and head-on fighting would only consume their own spiritual power.
If you want to break the situation, you must not fight. You can only break the formation quickly, decapitate the formation eyes, and use absolute explosive power to break the core of the formation!
A triangle formation must have an eye!
The Broken Arm Killer was injured and his spiritual power flow was stagnant. He was the weakest link among the three and the only flaw in the entire killing array!
"Set up formation! Kill!"
Before Shen Yan could move, the three killers reached a tacit consensus and shouted in unison. The spiritual energy all over their body exploded at the same time. Three gray spiritual energy waves converged, and the poisonous blades came out. Three deadly blade energy blocked the space, squeezing Shen Yan's dodge space, and encircled him in an instant!
The blade wind split the air, and the entire bamboo forest was violently violent. Pieces of thin bamboo broke at the waist, broken bamboos flew, and poisonous mist filled the sky. The pressure locked the body, making the limbs heavy and difficult to speed up.
The deadlock is completely formed!
"You think you can defeat me just by relying on numbers and formation?"
The corners of Shen Yan's lips were raised coldly, his eyes were sharp, and the light blue spiritual power of his dantian was gushing out unreservedly. The power of the blood of the green-scaled dragon in his body instantly boiled and swam, his muscles and bones roared, and a warm blue spiritual membrane floated on the surface of his skin. His physical strength instantly reached its peak!
The bloody battles in the ancient forest, the fights between dragons and beasts, and the instincts carved into the bone marrow by life and death battles were all awakened at this moment.
Flowing clouds and broken moon steps! full speed!
The footwork moves, the landing point is unparalleled, not dodging the killing blade energy on both sides, not avoiding the bone-eroding poisonous fog that fills the sky, Shen Yan abandons the defense of the whole body, and his body transforms into a stream of cyan light, going against the blade wind, charging forward in a straight line, aiming directly at the injured and broken-arm killer!
Abandon the defense and focus! Break the formation with one sword!
"Arrogant! How dare you take the initiative to charge into the battle!" The wandering assassin on the flank suddenly shrank and shouted harshly. He immediately turned the tip of his blade and slashed the soft ribs on Shen Yan's waist, intending to exchange the injury for injury and force Shen Yan to retreat.
The frontal blade killers speed up simultaneously, and the poisonous blades pierce the air sea in Shen Yan's dantian, striking hard and leaving no room for chance.
Two poisonous blades, attacking from the front and back, were about to pierce Shen Yan's body!
clang! clang!
Two crisp sounds of gold and stone colliding with loud bangs!
The poisonous blade slashed at the dragon blood spiritual membrane, causing sparks to fly and the blade body to tremble violently. The black blue toxin could not penetrate the spiritual membrane at all, leaving only two shallow white marks, which were directly bounced away by the brute force of the body!
Forging the body with dragon scales, there is no solution in the same situation!
"Can't break the defense? What kind of body is this!" The two killers were shocked, and for the first time, they felt extreme fear in their hearts.
For martial disciples in the same realm, spiritual power is the foundation, and the physical body is the supplement. This is a general knowledge of martial arts. However, Shen Yan subverts all common sense. His spiritual power is strong, his body is comparable to monsters, and he is both offensive and defensive, with no shortcomings!
